subsystems.name: Entanglement sources
subsystems.role: generate the correlated photon pairs that links carry.
parts: spontaneous parametric down-conversion crystals or waveguides
heralding detectors to confirm a pair exists

subsystems.name: Quantum channels
subsystems.role: move photons between nodes without losing them.
parts: free-space or satellite paths for hard-to-reach nodes
wavelength-division multiplexing to share fibre with classical traffic

subsystems.name: Network nodes with memories
subsystems.role: hold one half of an entangled pair while the rest of the route is established.
parts: matter qubits (trapped ions, neutral atoms, colour centres in diamond, rare-earth crystals)
local logic for measurement and readout

subsystems.name: Repeater and swap stations
subsystems.role: join two shorter links into one longer entangled connection, and purify noisy results.

subsystems.name: Synchronisation and classical control
subsystems.role: keep photon arrivals interfering correctly and coordinate requests.
parts: picosecond-scale clock distribution and time tagging
classical signalling channel alongside the quantum one

subsystems.name: Detectors and cryogenics
subsystems.role: count individual photons reliably and quiet the qubits.
parts: shielding from stray light and heat

buildSteps.title: Design the node stack
buildSteps.detail: Decide which physical qubit each node uses and how a photon couples in and out — the choice fixes memory lifetime, fidelity and operating temperature.

buildSteps.title: Build and characterise sources
buildSteps.detail: Fabricate pair sources, measure brightness and fidelity, and select pairs whose photons are indistinguishable enough to interfere with photons from other nodes.

buildSteps.title: Convert photons to telecom wavelengths
buildSteps.detail: Many good sources and memories emit at visible wavelengths, where fibre loss is brutal; non-linear frequency conversion shifts them to 1310 or 1550 nm.

buildSteps.title: Lay and instrument the channels
buildSteps.detail: Use existing fibre where possible, add wavelength multiplexing so the quantum signal coexists with normal data traffic, and compensate polarisation drift continuously.

buildSteps.title: Extract entanglement into memories
buildSteps.detail: Detect one photon of a pair to herald success, then store its partner in a matter qubit so it survives while the neighbouring link is retried.

buildSteps.title: Swap to bridge links
buildSteps.detail: At intermediate stations, perform a joint measurement on photons from two adjacent links; a successful result entangles the two end nodes without the photons ever meeting.

buildSteps.title: Purify the result
buildSteps.detail: Consume several lower-fidelity entangled pairs to distil one better pair, trading rate for quality.

buildSteps.title: Synchronise and automate
buildSteps.detail: Distribute a common clock, build the classical messaging layer, and let a control plane schedule who gets entangled with whom and when.

buildSteps.title: Demonstrate and scale
buildSteps.detail: Operate a small multi-node testbed in a city, then add nodes and longer repeater chains, increasing rate and distance together.

prerequisites.why: parametric down-conversion is mature and produces high-fidelity pairs; brightness and indistinguishability still limit rate.
storage has been shown in several platforms, but combining high efficiency, second-scale coherence and telecom compatibility in one device is not yet routine.
demonstrated for a handful of nodes in the lab; it must work repeatedly and with high fidelity to build a network.
protocols work in experiments but cost many pairs per improved pair, so rates collapse at network scale.

prerequisites.tech: Telecom single-photon detection and frequency conversion
prerequisites.why: detectors are excellent but need cryogenics; conversion efficiency to 1550 nm is around half and needs to rise.
independent photons only interfere if arrivals are aligned to picoseconds across the whole network.

pathway.milestone: metro-scale point-to-point entanglement and QKD links, plus small lab testbeds
pathway.unlocks: real fibre, real loss, real polarisation drift as engineering lessons.

pathway.milestone: multi-node entanglement routing with memories at each node, over tens of kilometres
pathway.unlocks: entanglement available on demand rather than pre-arranged between a fixed pair.

pathway.milestone: repeater chains spanning hundreds of kilometres, with purification keeping fidelity usable
pathway.unlocks: entanglement between cities, and a basis for distributed quantum sensing and blind computation.

pathway.milestone: intercity networks offering entanglement as a routed service
pathway.unlocks: applications that are not yet fully known, the way packet routing enabled the web.
